title: Service Test / Test 14: Isolation water valve

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 36 in 31 cu ft French Door Refrigerator (W11819775B)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics active. Use ▲/▼ to reach the test number for this procedure; Freezer to enter.

steps.title: Activate valve via IM test
steps.body: Run FC IM test mode — water valve energizes at end of cycle. Or verify household supply and pressure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run FC IM test mode — water valve energizes at end of cycle. Or verify household supply and pressure.

steps.title: Check valve voltage
steps.body: CN15-1 V-L to CN15-3 ACN = 115 VAC at ACU. At valve: blue to red = 115 VAC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: CN15-1 V-L to CN15-3 ACN = 115 VAC at ACU. At valve: blue to red = 115 VAC.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: No water — valve, supply, or frozen line.

steps.title: Replace isolation water valve
steps.oemOutcome: Replace valve when 115 VAC present but no flow.
